project_metadata.title: 三隻小豬的森林冒險
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, rich fairytale mood, soft cinematic lighting, highly detailed environments.

protagonist.name: 豬小弟
protagonist.outfit: Blue denim overalls and a tiny red belt.

supporting_characters.name: 豬大哥
supporting_characters.outfit: Green striped shirt and a straw hat.

supporting_characters.name: 豬二哥
supporting_characters.outfit: Yellow checkered shirt and brown suspenders.

supporting_characters.name: 大野狼
supporting_characters.outfit: Torn purple vest and rugged gray fur.

character_registry.relationship_dynamics: The youngest pig is hardworking and protective of his lazy older brothers. The wolf is a hungry predator trying to hunt the pigs down.

environment.location: A wide dirt path deep in the lush green forest.
environment.key_elements: Tall ancient trees, green bushes, scattered pebbles.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright sunlight filtering through leaves, cheerful and adventurous mood.

scenes.narration: 豬爸爸和豬媽媽叮嚀三兄弟要小心大野狼。於是，他們帶著行李出發，走進了森林深處。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 豬大哥 is walking lazily. In the center, 豬二哥 is stretching his arms. On the right, 豬小弟 is marching forward energetically. Wide shot.

environment.location: A grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: A massive pile of glowing golden straw.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm afternoon sunlight hitting the straw, lazy and peaceful vibe.

scenes.narration: 豬大哥覺得好累，找了最輕的乾草當材料。他隨便把乾草疊一疊，新房子就蓋好了。
scenes.image_prompt: 豬大哥 is throwing bundles of straw onto a messy pile, yawning widely with a sleepy expression. Medium shot.

environment.location: Another spot in the grassy clearing.
environment.key_elements: Rough wooden logs and scattered branches.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Sun slowly setting, casting slightly longer shadows over the wood.

scenes.narration: 豬二哥撿了些木頭，連釘子都懶得用。他隨意把木頭堆起來，也算完成了自己的家。
scenes.image_prompt: 豬二哥 is clumsily stacking wooden logs, wiping sweat from his forehead with an exhausted look. Close-up shot.

environment.location: A solid patch of land in the clearing.
environment.key_elements: A sturdy pile of gray stones, a wooden bucket filled with wet mud.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden hour lighting, emphasizing hard work, dedication and warm tones.

scenes.narration: 只有豬小弟選擇了最堅固的石頭。他仔細地用泥漿把石頭緊緊黏結，決心要擋住大野狼。
scenes.image_prompt: 豬小弟 is carefully applying mud to a heavy stone block, wearing a highly determined expression. Wide shot.

environment.location: Dark bushes at the edge of the clearing.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold moonlight, dark and mysterious shadows, highly suspenseful atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 夜晚降臨，森林裡出現一雙銳利的眼睛。凶惡的大野狼正躲在暗處，盤算著今晚的美味大餐。
scenes.image_prompt: 大野狼 is lurking behind the bushes, showing a wicked smirk and staring hungrily forward. Medium shot.

environment.location: In front of the flimsy straw house.
environment.key_elements: Scattered straw flying wildly in the air.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold silver moonlight, chaotic and terrifying mood.

scenes.narration: 大野狼來到乾草屋前，用力一吹。呼的一聲！整間乾草屋瞬間被吹得無影無蹤，嚇壞了豬大哥。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 大野狼 is taking a massive breath and blowing powerfully. On the right, 豬大哥 is running away frantically with arms flailing. Wide shot.

environment.location: In front of the wooden house.
environment.key_elements: Scattered wooden logs rolling on the ground.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh shadows from the moonlight, conveying extreme panic and danger.

scenes.narration: 豬大哥急忙躲進二哥的木屋。大野狼追了過來再次用力一吹，嘩啦嘩啦，木頭散落了一地！
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 大野狼 is blowing violently. On the right, 豬二哥 is tumbling over scattered logs in pure panic. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: Solid stone walls, a roaring fireplace, a heavy wooden door.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm, safe orange glow from the fireplace contrasting with the cold night outside.

scenes.narration: 兩兄弟拔腿跑進豬小弟的石頭屋躲起來。豬小弟拍拍胸脯，自信地要哥哥們放心。
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 豬大哥 is trembling. In the center, 豬二哥 is crying. On the right, 豬小弟 is standing protectively with a confident smile. Wide shot.

environment.key_elements: Solid stone walls with thick mud joints.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cold moonlight highlighting the unmoving solid texture of the stones.

scenes.narration: 大野狼站在門前用盡全力一直吹。他吹到臉紅脖子粗，堅固的石頭屋卻連晃都沒有晃一下。
scenes.image_prompt: 大野狼 is puffing his cheeks out to the maximum, face turning red with extreme effort and immense frustration. Close-up shot.

environment.location: The roof of the brick house.
environment.key_elements: A stone chimney, roof tiles, the bright full moon.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Silhouetted against the bright moon, sneaky and suspenseful atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 又氣又餓的大野狼心生一計。他看見屋頂上的煙囪，得意地笑了笑，努力爬了上去。
scenes.image_prompt: 大野狼 is sneaking carefully onto the roof tiles, looking down into the chimney with a wicked, triumphant grin. Wide shot.

environment.location: Inside the brick house, beneath the chimney.
environment.key_elements: A large iron cauldron, boiling water, a roaring fire.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Intense heat and bright orange firelight illuminating the room from below.

scenes.narration: 聰明冷靜的豬小弟早就料到大野狼的計畫。他趕緊在火爐上，煮了一大鍋熱滾滾的開水。
scenes.image_prompt: 豬小弟 is stirring a bubbling cauldron over a roaring fire, looking upwards with a sharp, prepared gaze. Medium shot.

environment.key_elements: The iron cauldron, huge splashes of water.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright, joyful, and triumphant lighting from the fireplace.

scenes.narration: 咻的一聲！大野狼順著煙囪滑下來，撲通掉進熱水裡燙死了。三隻小豬終於可以安心睡覺了！
scenes.image_prompt: On the left, 大野狼 is falling straight down into the splashing pot with a shocked expression. On the right, 豬小弟 is jumping and cheering. Close-up shot.
